---
name: visual-conformance-review
description: Independently verify implementation against a Design Contract and produce Core-owned evidence.
---

# Visual conformance review

Verifier must differ from the implementer. Capture each required
route/state/viewport on the exact commit. Classify divergences; advisory
references never auto-block. Refuse agent-claimed passes when Core recomputation
finds blocking defects. Tolerances come only from the Design Contract.
